image_activation.source_requirement: Legitimate Kenyan supplier/manufacturer product page whose title or URL explicitly matches exact product name/model and pack size.
image_activation.storage_verification: Storage object exists and exact stored URL is referenced in products.images.
image_activation.activation: Set active=true immediately after source identity, technical image, storage reference, price, SEO and regulatory gates pass.
image_activation.missing_or_mismatched_image: Keep inactive; do not use generic substitutes.

regulatory_gate: PCPB registration, registered use, exact product identity and label restrictions remain mandatory; this image rule does not waive regulatory checks.
scud_exception: Keep SCUD 5 WP variants inactive until 50g/kg versus 50g/L concentration discrepancy is resolved from the physical Kenyan label.

description_formatting.storage_format: Plain text/Markdown; canonical ## headings on their own lines; never raw HTML
required_sections: Where & How to Use in Kenya
description_formatting.faq_jsonld: Exactly four detailed buyer Q&As under Frequently Asked Questions, synchronised 1:1 with product FAQPage JSON-LD.
description_formatting.internal_links_per_guide: 2-3 natural relevant links to category or /services/ pages
description_formatting.safety: Never invent product facts, pesticide rates, registered uses, warranty, PPE or handling directions; use verified label/source facts only.
description_formatting.word_count: 800+ useful words where supported by verified sources; never pad or fabricate.
canonical_section_labels: Where & How to Use in Kenya
description_formatting.bullet_lists: Use real bullet lists for verified specifications and checklists.
description_formatting.internal_links: 2–3 relevant links to category pages, commercial buying guides, or /services/ pages.
description_formatting.delivery_details: M-Pesa checkout, Sarit Centre Westlands pickup coordination, delivery across all 47 counties subject to courier and stock coverage, WhatsApp +254 748 888 230.
description_formatting.chemical_safety: Never invent dilution rates, approved uses, PPE, label instructions, registration, efficacy, warranty or safety claims.

pricing.baseline_source: Lowest reliable Kenyan wholesale/distributor price; if only reputable in-stock retail exists, baseline = lowest retail x 0.85.
pricing.syngenta: Skip new Syngenta pricing and leave existing Syngenta price/cost unchanged unless owner explicitly instructs otherwise.
pricing.database_enforcement: public.products_posting_rules() recalculates every new insert using public.price_4tier(cost).
